publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: There has been a lot of progress in the development of machine learning for us to develop the understandings of the machinery mind. Machines can comprehend situations of strengthening developed neurons in the same way that neurons in the brain automatically trigger and quickly perform learned tasks. Following these layers of different commemorations and accuracy that Artificial Intelligence provides, many unsolved issues can be solved here by one machine, problems, and tasks, because the machine is now capable of approaching the task as if it’s thought process is as same as that of a human brain with a precise accuracy. articleTitle: Effective Intrusion Detection System using Hybrid Ensemble Method for Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Due to its adaptability and pay-per-use services, cloud computing has grown in popularity among businesses, but security and privacy issues are still very much present. Intruders can exploit vulnerabilities in the open and dispersed nature of cloud environments, leading to attacks that can damage entire projects within a short period of time. To address this issue, organizations need to implement effective intrusion detection systems (IDS) that can detect and alert administrators of any suspicious activities. There are three widely used methods for IDS: signature-based detection, anomaly-based detection, and hybrid detection. Hybrid detection, which combines the strengths of signature-based and anomaly-based detection, has been shown to produce superior results. IDS can be categorized into host-based IDS (HIDS), network-based IDS (NIDS), hypervisor-based IDS, and distributed IDS (DIDS), each with their own unique characteristics and benefits. The CICIDS2017 dataset provides a diverse set of attacks and benign traffic for researchers and practitioners to develop and evaluate IDS systems. Overall, putting in place a strong intrusion detection system is critical for maintaining the security and privacy of cloud-based projects, as well as ensuring their availability.

articleTitle: IoT Product on Smart Water Quality Monitoring System (Iot Wq-Kit) for Puducherry Union Territory
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Availability and quality of water is becoming global demand and has started to apply enormous pressure on usage of natural resources which increases day by day. As Puducherry is a tourist city, the need for ensuring water quality and conserving the water resources is also reaching greater importance. Pollution concentration increased due to domestic sewage and industrial effluents ceases the Quality of Water. These confronts arise due to heavy population and low natural water resources. If quality parameters are identified during the initial stages, it enables the implementation of appropriate actions, thus preventing critical situations. The Internet of Things (IoT) is the recent technological solution for monitoring and management of water resources available. The majority of methods aimed at mitigating water pollution involve biological and laboratory-based techniques, which result in extended time and resource utilization. To Control Water Quality Pollution, water quality monitoring is required in real time. In order to tackle this problem, we have created an IoT based Water Quality monitoring kit (WQ Kit) system designed for monitoring various water quality parameters such as pH, Dissolved Oxygen (DO), Alkalinity, Salinity, Total Dissolved Solids (TDS), Conductivity, Temperature, Turbidity, and additionally quantifying water consumption in the Puducherry Region. The system stores historical readings on a cloud platform in real time. The developed IoT system leads to data acquisition, wireless data transmission and processing the data in the cloud in real time. The IoT system will provide the ability to automatically react based on the changes in Water Quality to attract many more tourists to Puducherry. This provides an easy user-friendly interface with graphical representation and Mobile Application to illustrate the acceptable quality factors values.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Nutrient Deficiency symptoms in plant leaves using Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: A novel approach of detecting nutrient deficients of plants based on leaf images has been introduced. One approach involves breaking down the original leaf image into smaller segments and examining each segment using custom-designed convolutional neural networks (CNNs) that have been trained to recognize indications of nutrient deficiencies. The responses from all the CNNs are integrated using a winner-take-all strategy to generate a single response for each block. The final response for the entire leaf is obtained by integrating the responses from all the blocks using a multi-layer perceptron. The method was tested on a sample of 3,000 leaf pictures and was discovered to be more effective than human professionals in detecting nutrient deficiencies. Plants heavily depend on soil nutrients, and when there is a deficiency, some nutrients can be transported from older tissue to newer tissue. To understand the effects of nitrogen deficiency, phosphorus deficiency, and complete nutrient deficiency on plant growth, a study was conducted over four weeks. The findings revealed that all three deficiencies had a significant impact on growth capacity, and there were evident variations in chlorophyll content between the nitrogen- and phosphorus-deficient treatments compared to the complete nutrient treatment. These outcomes suggest that plant survival under environmental deficiencies cannot rely entirely on nutrient mobility and must adapt to thrive.

articleTitle: Wireless Vehicle to Vehicle Charging using Inductive Power Transfer Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The advancement of technology in vehicle charging systems has made it possible to incorporate V2V (Vehicle-to-Vehicle) charging as a viable option. With the continuous progress in wireless power transfer, communication protocols and smart grid integration, V2V charging has become a promising solution for electric vehicles, the sending vehicle (known as the transmitter) transfers power wirelessly to the receiving vehicle (known as the receiver). This transfer typically occurs through electromagnetic induction or resonant coupling, where coils in both vehicles generate a magnetic field that enables energy transfer. V2V charging can promote energy sharing and efficiency within a network of EVs, as vehicles with excess energy can contribute to charging others with lower battery levels. Overall, V2V charging presents an innovative approach to expand charging capabilities and enhance the usability of electric vehicles, contributing to the growth and adoption of sustainable transportation.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient Scheduling in Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Fog computing, extends the capabilities of cloud computing to the network’s edge. This paradigm aims to minimize latency and facilitate real-time processing for edge devices, offering a more efficient and responsive computing environment. It decentralizes computing resources, enhancing scalability, security, and resource efficiency while optimizing data privacy. By bringing computer resources and services closer to devices and endpoints, it seeks to overcome the limits of centralized cloud architecture. Effectively scheduling tasks in fog computing remains challenged due to the dynamic nature of industrial IOT (IIoT) devices nature and their limited resources. Ant Colony optimization (ACO) plays a major role in addressing fog computing’s task scheduling difficulties. In this study, an optimisation method called ant colony optimisation (ACO) is used to propose a fog computing task scheduling solution for Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) applications. By mimicking the searching behaviour of ants, it finds optimal task scheduling by considering the factors like time taken for execution, network utilisation, and consumption of energy. In order to evaluate the performance, the Ant colony optimized scheduler, the proposed method has to be compared with extant methods using iFogSim simulator. When compared with First come first serve (FCFS) based scheduling, the Ant colony optimization (ACO) based scheduling attains 14.34% reduction in energy consumption, 44.74% reduction in network usage and a 50% faster in executing the tasks.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Analysis of Prenatal Syndrome Using USG Images
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Prenatal syndromes encompass a wide range of congenital conditions that affect fetal development during pregnancy. This research paper aims to provide an overview of prenatal syndromes, including their causes, diagnosis, and management strategies. These syndromes often arise due to genetic mutations, chromosomal abnormalities, or other factors that impact fetal development. Prenatal syndromes can result in a wide range of physical, cognitive, and developmental challenges for the affected individual. Common examples of prenatal syndromes include Down syndrome (Trisomy 21), Edwards syndrome (Trisomy 18), Patau syndrome (Trisomy 13), and Turner syndrome (monosomy X), among others. These syndromes are typically associated with distinct clinical features and may require specialized medical care and interventions for that preprocessing and feature extraction was done by inception v3 algorithm. In this training and testing of images are done from that loss are minimized.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Finite Element Modelling for Enhanced Breast Cancer Detection using Electrical Impedance Tomography and Ultrasound Tomography
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Breast cancer is a vital global health concern, necessitating the development of advanced imaging methodologies for early and accurate detection. Although several standard approaches are available, due to their low sensitivity, inability to recognize cancer in denser breasts, radiation exposure, and high cost, they paved way for future research. This paper introduces a novel approach by utilising the dual modality for breast cancer detection by integrating the Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT) and Ultrasound Tomography (UT) methods. A simulation-based study using Finite Element Modelling (FEM) is used to solve the forward problem of both modalities using COMSOL Multiphysics software. Here, 16 Ag/Agcl electrodes and 16 ultrasonic piezoelectric transducers were positioned alternately in a 2D circular breast model. Patient-specific FEM meshes enhance the accuracy of EIT and ultrasound imaging. The fusion of these modalities offers a promising avenue for early and precise breast cancer detection, with the potential to transform diagnostics and improve patient health care.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Model for the Early Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease in Patients
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is a major health concern worldwide, with an estimated 17.9 million deaths each year. It encompasses a range of conditions affecting the heart and blood vessels, including coronary heart disease, stroke, and heart failure. These diseases are often associated with a range of modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors, including high blood pressure, high cholesterol, smoking, physical inactivity, obesity, diabetes, and genetic predisposition. Data analysis and machine learning have emerged as powerful tools for predicting and preventing cardiovascular disease. By analysing large and complex datasets of medical records, researchers can identify patterns and risk factors associated with cardiovascular disease. Machine learning models can help identify important features in the data that are predictive of heart disease outcomes, and can be used to develop accurate and reliable predictive models. Moreover, data analysis can help identify disparities and biases in cardiovascular disease outcomes across different populations and regions. This research aims to develop a machine-learning model for predicting cardiovascular disease risk using benchmark datasets. Various imputation techniques, including Mean, Median, Most Frequent, KNNI, and the proposed risk prediction model, are compared in terms of accuracy and efficiency. The CatBoost classification algorithm is used for developing the proposed model, achieving an accuracy of 91% for the Hungarian dataset. This research provides valuable insights into the use of machine learning and data analysis for predicting cardiovascular disease and improving healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: mChemID: Android Application for Chemical Reactions using Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In the ever-evolving field of chemistry, the need for efficient and user-friendly tools to identify chemical reactions has become crucial. mChemID, a mobile application that leverages speech recognition technology to enable users to input chemical elements verbally and retrieve corresponding reactions from a cloud-based database, streamlining the learning process for students, educators, and researchers. It utilizes speech recognition technology to identify chemical reactions by the speech input as chemical elements. Objective: The primary objective is to develop a user-friendly mobile application, mChemID, that utilizes speech recognition technology to assist individuals in identifying chemical reactions by chemical elements through voice input. The application aims to provide a convenient and efficient tool for users to retrieve chemical symbols and corresponding reactions from a cloud-based database. Methodology: The Android platform’s built-in speech recognition functionality is used to verbally input chemical element names. Google’s speech-to-text service is used for transcription, ensuring accurate recognition. The application’s design and development are carried out using Android Studio, a popular development environment for Android applications. Cloud-based connectivity is integrated into the application to fetch and access the required chemical reaction data from a central database. Outcome: The mChemID offers a user-friendly and efficient means to facilitate and simplify the understanding and study of chemical reactions, contributing to the advancement of chemical knowledge and research.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Post Traumatic Stress Disorder through Speech-Based Emotion Modelling with 1D CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In contemporary society, Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD) continues to carry a stigma, as it denotes an individual who struggles to move beyond a concluded traumatic event. This study uses Deep Learning algorithm to tackle PTSD from the perspective of emotion recognition. An assessment instrument typically used by a psychiatrist to make the diagnosis of PTSD is a survey form. Scores derived from questionnaire-based assessments are deemed unreliable, and they have the potential to induce anxiety, distress, and discomfort among patients. Non-stationary signals, which include speech signals, are the most widely used biomarkers of emotion recognition. Mel spectrogram features are derived from emotional speech from the RAVDESS database for this study. The 1D CNN classifier’s performance metrics are calculated for each emotion. The findings indicate that the straightforward 1D CNN prediction model surpasses current alternatives, demonstrating superior performance of classification accuracy with average of 88.54% for the diagnosis of PTSD.

Author Keywords: Mel Spectrogram features and Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder

articleTitle: Real-Time Vehicular Traffic Flow Monitoring and Classification of Vehicles for Indian Road Scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: One of the biggest issues in the majority of big cities is traffic. In order to decide on traffic control techniques and management, it is crucial to classify the current traffic circumstances. Because so much time is lost in traffic, it has a bad effect on society and has to be controlled. By classifying, we can determine which lane has traffic, from which we may further investigate the causes of traffic and make the necessary decisions to optimize performance. A good source for traffic analysis is the video of traffic data. In this study, road traffic is monitored using a convolution neural network from video surveillance data. When compared to other monitoring techniques, the convolution neural network requires the least amount of preprocessing. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) require minimal preprocessing compared to traditional computer vision methods. They avoid labour-intensive steps such as manual feature engineering, where human experts design features from images. CNNs autonomously learn relevant features from raw pixel data, saving time and enhancing adaptability. They also eliminate the need for colour space conversion, as they can handle multi-channel input, preserving colour information. Additionally, CNNs can work with a variety of pixel value distributions without extensive normalization and learn to perform image segmentation without thresholding. This streamlines the workflow, making CNNs more efficient and effective in tasks like object detection, image classification, and segmentation. This model can analyze live streaming video, classify each frame, and rate the amount of traffic in each lane, both of which are useful for traffic monitoring.

articleTitle: An FPGA based Real-Time Video Processing system on Zynq 7010
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Real-Time Image Processing involves the transformation of incoming signals, primarily from a camera, into a format that can be readily interpreted by a display device. This process is heavily reliant on precise timing constraints, demanding efficient hardware execution. This paper proposes an innovative method for interfacing the OV7670 Complementary Metal Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) Camera with an FPGA-based Real-Time Image Processing system on a Zynq 7010 platform, using the open-source Digilent Dynamic Clock Generator. The architecture is characterized by it’s parallel processing capability of both controlling the camera output signals and processing the signals and converting them from RGB to DVI format on the fly. In lieu of the traditional PLL based clocking wizard, which provides a fixed clock signal, the open-source Dynamic Clock Generator has been incorporated in the architecture to generate the essential pixel clock, meeting the real-time clocking requirements. The RGB to DVI(Digital Visual Interface) block has been coded in VHDL to convert the output from AXI4-Stream to Video Out Xilinx IP Core to TMDS (Transition-Minimized Differential Signaling data, to be interpreted by an HDMI compatible monitor.

articleTitle: Book Recommendation System using Matrix Factorization with SVD
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The paper introduces a Book Recommendation System that leverages Matrix Factorization with Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) to address the challenge of an overwhelming number of books in online platforms. By analyzing user-item interactions within book rating datasets, the system identifies latent components representing reader preferences and book attributes. Through SVD, the approach enhances this decomposition to capture crucial latent factors. Personalized book recommendations are then generated based on a user’s preferences and estimated ratings from other users. Evaluation results illustrate the system’s effectiveness in capturing user preferences and providing more accurate and diverse recommendations.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Medical Image Denoising using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Medical images are considered as one of the most important medical data for diagnosis and treatment purposes. For remote consultation and diagnosis, the medical images are frequently transferred using different communication methods. There is a chance of noise degradation of these medical images during transmission. Denoising such medical images is crucial for enhancing the quality and diagnostic precision. The remarkable ability of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to effectively denoise medical images has attracted considerable interest. This paper discusses various CNN architectures, training strategies, and data augmentation techniques for denoising tasks. In addition, the difficulties and limitations of CNN-based denoising techniques, such as computational complexity and data scarcity, are discussed. In addition, incorporating Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and transfer learning for improved denoising performance are discussed. This survey aims to serve as a valuable resource for researchers, clinicians, and developers by fostering a better comprehension of the current state-of-the-art techniques and future directions in medical image denoising using CNNs.

articleTitle: Design of Rectangular Slotted Microstrip Patch Antenna for V2V Communication at 38GHz
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Road accidents are considered one of the principal cause of hospitalizations, injuries, deaths, and disabilities globally, including India. Approximately 150,000 people losing their lives each year in road crashes. various factors contribute to the major number of traffic accidents and fatalities in worldwide, including over speeding, lane violations, non-usage of safety devices and disregarding traffic signals. In this scenario the most effective way to enhance road safety and mitigate these issues, one is to provide drivers with real-time information such as accident warnings, emergency alerts, collision alerts, etc. The timely notifications can significantly contribute to make a safer driving conditions. Addressing these needs, the Advances in mobile technology plays a vital role in autonomous driving systems by providing real time data of road scenario can improve road safety, and also it has a significant influence on enhancing infotainment systems, enabling advanced navigation, and facilitating telemetric services. In order to meet the digital intelligence autonomous driving demands, the 5G communication is being opted for V2V communication as it offers a ultra-Reliable Low Latency Communication (uRLLC) with high data rates. Antenna design plays a critical role in enhancing 5G networks for V2V communication. In this paper, a slotted microstrip patch antenna operating at 38 GHz is designed and presented. The antenna design results in a peak gain of 16 dBi at 38 GHz, along with a maximum radiation efficiency of 97.64%. It also exhibits an improved Return Loss (S11) of -28.27 dB and a VSWR of 1.08.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Text-based Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Emotion Detection is part of sentiment analysis which detects emotions at a finer grain level of classifying the exact emotions instead of classifying them in general as positive and negative emotions. Emotion detection research is a recent field where emotions are detected from facial images, video, audio, and text. This paper focuses on emotion detection from textual data. Here this work proposes a hybrid model built using the doc2vec model, CNN model, Bi-GRU, and attention mechanism. In the proposed model initially, a Doc2vec model is used to transform the text into vectors. The doc2vec model captures the semantic information and this information is fed into the CNN model. The CNN model captures the local features. Bi-LSTM, GRU, and Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (Bi-GRU) are used to learn the contextual features. The built model performance is fine-tuned by using an attention mechanism and dropout regularization. The model was tested with the standard benchmark datasets IMDB and Emotions dataset. The proposed hybrid model produced an accuracy of 82.84% for multi-class classification.

articleTitle: Recovery of Edge Pixels for Facial Expression Recognition using Edge Fusion Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Detection of edges is an inevitable part in the realm of Image Processing. In detecting the emotional state of a person, the facial feature extraction of the facial components like eyes, eyebrows, lips etc. play a significant part in accurately classifying the facial expressions wherein the role played by edge detection is very vital. The discontinuity or abrupt change in the pixel intensity is typically represented by edges. Although there are numerous edge detection operators, getting the finest outcomes from the current system is a huge difficulty. Perfect edge detection ensures capturing of accurate features. This paper presents an edge fusion technique for facial images which combines the Sobel and the Canny detected edges of the facial images with the Active Appearance Model (AAM) which is also a statistical face modelling algorithm so that the outcome of the fusion is used to visualize the completeness of the edges and the localization of the facial components in an enhanced way. The performance of this edge fusion technique discussed here seems to be promising in deducing the image metrics necessary to confirm the emotional condition depicted by the face.

articleTitle: Eco-Friendly Mobility: Design and Implementation of an Electric Three-Wheeler for Efficient Logistics
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: With the continuing depletion of conventional fossil fuel resources, energy security is becoming a growing concern for almost all countries around the world. Automobiles, being the major consumers of fossil fuel sources, contribute significantly to the major causes of pollution and climate change. Approximately one-fifth of the world’s carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions are attributed to transportation, with logistics accounting for more than 50% of these emissions. Transitioning from conventional fuels to electricity is now widely discussed as a viable option for achieving a greener economy. Extensive research is underway on electric vehicles, but the electric vehicle technology is still in a very nascent stage of development. Multinational mobility companies have already introduced 2-wheel and 4-wheel logistics and passenger electric vehicles. However, goods carrier vehicles play a crucial role in global mobility. In this project, we propose to develop a 3-wheeled electric auto for sustainable logistics. Electricity is used to charge the batteries in electric vehicles instead of fossil fuels like petrol or diesel. Moreover, it is a more cost-effective, eco-friendly, and efficient option.

articleTitle: A more generalized algorithm of Vedic sutra: Urdhva-Tiryagbhyam for 2n-bit square calculation using Quantum-dots
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In this paper, a square calculator has been implemented by employing one of the Vedic sutras with the help of Quantum-dot Cellular Automata (QCA) technology. It is well known that the complexity can be reduced by using Vedic sutras when designing multipliers. We have used ‘Urdhva-Tiryagbhyam’ to implement a square calculator. First, a standard 2-bit square calculator (SC1) has been developed with a QCA layout. Furthermore, using the most recent XOR gate, an optimized 2-bit square calculator (SC2) has been implemented. Later, a 4-bit square calculator (SC3) has also been developed using the aforementioned Vedic sutra. The proposed designs have a smaller number of Quantum cells, area, and delay compared to the existing models. The energy and power dissipation have also been calculated for the proposed models which proves that the proposed models SC2 and SC3 would be the best among the existing ones. The power dissipation of the proposed 2-bit and 4-bit square calculator is 1.79nW and 4.36nW respectively.

articleTitle: Phasor Measurement Unit Based Fault Detection using Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: This study focuses on the creation of a fault detection system using phasor measurement units (PMUs) and neural network. PMUs are devices that can measure electrical quantities in power system, such as positive sequence voltage, current phasors, and frequency with timestamp. PMU data can be used by fault detection system to determine the occurrence of fault and location of faults in the power system. Neural network is used in this study to analyse PMU data and detect power system faults. The neural network is trained using dataset of PMU for simulating power system faults. Neural network is giving high accuracy for detection of place of fault and type of fault identification. The proposed system has been evaluated and compared with existing fault detection technique using simulation studies. The result shows that the proposed system can detect faults in the power system and outperforms existing techniques in terms of accuracy and detection speed. This research could lead to the development of more efficient and reliable fault detection systems for power system, resulting in better power system operation and reliability.

articleTitle: A Novel IoT Based Railway Platform Safety
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Railway transportation is the most preferred means of transportation because of its various advantages like being affordable; it’s wide stretch among most parts of the country etc. Railway stations are found almost every part of our country. Maintenance of these stations is added feature for much safer and comfortable railway transportation. People falling into railway track when there is a train entering or leaving the platform and platform suicides are few of the accidents that might happen in railway station. Through this paper we are addressing this issue by installing automated gating system along the railway platform; the model is built using IoT sensors like IR sensor. As this is a model operates outdoors, we have built this model to be simple and operate with as less maintenance as possible.

articleTitle: Efficient Hyperbola Detection and Fitting using Image Processing Techniques and Column-Connection Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) is a preferred non-destructive method used for the identification and localisation of subsurface targets. Hyperbolic signatures present in GPR B-Scans can provide valuable insights about the shape, material and the distance at which target objects are buried below the surface. This paper presents an innovative approach to enhance GPR data analysis, specifically focusing on hyperbola detection within GPR B-Scans. Preprocessing steps, such as dewow filtering, frequency filtering, and gain compensation, are used to improve GPR data quality. A comparative analysis is conducted on the performance of Canny, Sobel, and Scharr edge detectors in identifying hyperbolic signatures. By merging the Canny edge detection algorithm with the Column-Connection Clustering (C3) method, common limitations of conventional clustering, particularly their sensitivity to noise and outliers are addressed. Finally, the efficacy of the proposed method is evaluated by calculating the R-squared values of the fitted hyperbolas which was found to be > 0.93.

articleTitle: A Four-Port 5G Mobile phone MIMO Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: This article introduces a study focusing on a four-port MIMO antenna designed for use in 5G mobile phones. The antenna is designed to operate in the sub-6 GHz band. The antenna is of the size $150\times 80 \times$ 1.6mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> with a substrate thickness of 1.6 mm. The antenna exhibits a reflection coefficient value in the range of −19 to −26 dB for the operating frequency band of 5.15 GHz-5.925 GHz (covers LTE-46/LTE-U band). An isolation in the range of 15 to 23 dB is achieved between the elements.

articleTitle: Decagon Shaped Frequency Reconfigurable Antenna using PIN Diode
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Wireless Technology plays a vital role in almost every action of a human life. Due to continuous growth and development in the technology and increasing invention and innovations in wireless devices, Reconfigurable antennas play a vital role in current scenario of wireless technologies. The main component and for an efficient utilization of any wireless devices, antenna is the key element. In this paper, a Decagon slot with Defective Ground Structure (DGS) and pin diode is used for achieving Frequency Reconfigurability (FR). The substrate used in this antenna is the commonly used, FR4 epoxy with dielectric constant 4.4 and has the overall dimension of 58 x 76 x 1.6 mm$^{3}$ with a patch dimension of 29 mm x 38 mm. The proposed antenna operates in the band of 2.8 GHz to 17.5GHz with resonant frequencies at 14.3, 14.4 GHz with both pin diodes in on condition with a gain of 5.7 and 3.4 dB respectively. The resonant frequency of the antenna is achieved at 8.3, 14.4 GHz with a gain of 10.6 and 5.3 dB with a bandwidth of 4.5 and 15.5GHz respectively. With PIN diode 1 ON and PIN diode 2 OFF, relatively high gain of 12.1dB is achieved at resonant frequency of 8.3 GHz. The proposed design of the antenna is simulated using electromagnetic solver HFSS software. The proposed design of the antenna can be used in applications like radar imaging and broad band applications(X-band), satellite communications (Ku –band).

articleTitle: DAHS: Development of Android based Healthcare System using Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Cloud enables technologies which are used in healthcare such as mobile apps, electronic medical records, devices with IOT, patient portals, big data analytics. It delivers hassle-free flexibility besides scalability, which further progresses the final decision-making procedure. Using cloud computing, a healthcare system-based hospital finder application enables us to locate hospitals close to our current location. State, city, and hospital name are all search criteria that users can use. It shows us the best route to take to get to the hospital quickly. The proposed work is utilized in the event of a medical emergency (Accident, Cardio, etc.), and regular people frequently struggle to decide which hospital to go to in order to receive the necessary or specialized care. They wander between hospitals looking for healthcare facilities, medications, blood supplies, etc. Hospice Care Taker or Hospice Maestro (an Android App) is designed by means of android based cloud application and this will resolve the problem through permitting people in order to examine neighboring hospitals available with minimum distance on the basis of medical treatments, specialist doctors, medicine/blood availability, ambulance service etc. This android based cloud application offers instruction related to first aid for required/specific treatment and also affords user to show complete details of hospital with its open and close status.

articleTitle: IoT Based Vehicle Theft Detection and Accident Detection using Arduino
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Sustaining a sufficient traffic flow has become challenging owing to an exponential increase in vehicle traffic, especially in major metropolitan areas like Chennai and Bengaluru. The higher traffic density also increases the fuel usage and transportation costs. Road accidents occur as a result of traffic congestion, causing serious injury or death to road users Vehicle theft can now occur in various places, including vehicle parking lots and unsecured areas. This paper aims to monitor and detect a stolen vehicle and an accident using the Global Positioning System (GPS) and Global System for Mobile Communication (GSM) along with an Arduino. The vehicle’s location is tracked in latitude and longitude coordinates, and the location information is sent to the vehicle’s owner or traffic control room. The proposed system helps to reduce the time factor and identify the location of the vehicles faster.

articleTitle: Human Action Recognition using Fuzzy Logic and VGG16 Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Human action recognition (HAR) is a challenging task with applications in various domains such as surveillance, healthcare, and human-computer interaction. This paper aims to develop a HAR system using a combination of fuzzy logic and the VGG16 convolutional neural network (CNN). The proposed approach begins with the collection and preparation of a labeled dataset consisting of images representing different human activities. Preprocessing techniques are applied to enhance the quality and consistency of the images. Fuzzy logic is then utilized to predict the membership values for each action and perform fuzzy membership calculations on the training labels, leveraging its ability to capture ambiguity and uncertainty associated with human activities. The VGG16 CNN architecture, known for its effectiveness in image classification, is employed for feature extraction and classification. A pre-trained VGG16 model is finetuned on the HAR dataset, replacing the last layers to adapt it to the specific task. The model is trained using a training set while monitoring its performance on a validation set to optimize hyperparameters and ensure the model’s robustness. By combining fuzzy logic and the VGG16, this proposed HAR system, integrating fuzzy logic and the VGG16 CNN, exhibits promising potential for accurately recognizing human activities in images.

articleTitle: Blockchain-based Rice Seed Tracking: A Sustainable Agricultural Solution
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: India is a nation with a significant agricultural focus on the global stage. Despite its rich agricultural history, India faces the stark reality of struggling farmers, while foreign nations profit immensely from similar resources. This predicament can be attributed, in part, to inadequate Rice Seed Supplychain(RSSC) Management. This paper explores BCT’s potential to enhance traceability in the RSSC. It presents a framework for a secure, transparent RSSC system based on BCT. The proposed system ensures rice seeds’ safe and efficient distribution from seed companies to farmers. Through the recording of every step in the RSSC and the continuous quality monitoring of rice seeds, BCT ensures traceability and reduces the risk of fraudulent activities throughout the entire process. Implementing BCT in the traceability of the RSSC provides numerous benefits, including accurate and transparent information for farmers and improved trust between seed companies and farmers.

articleTitle: Triangular Shaped Truncated Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Patch Antenna for WLAN and Sub-6 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: A Triangular shaped truncated antenna whose frequency can be reconfigured for Fifth Generation New Radio n78 band wireless applications and Wireless Local Area Network is designed. Three iterations are carried out for the proposed antenna and in each iterative stage the results are validated. Initially in the first iterative stage a simple triangular patch is designed which produced a single band resonance at 2.18 GHz and by introducing a truncation to the triangular patch in the second iteration the resonant frequency shifted from 2.18GHz to 2.09GHz.The PIN diode is introduced in the truncation in order to produce reconfigurable frequency bands. In the third iteration the CSRR is introduced on either sides of the feeding line and this is accountable for the augmented frequency response of the antenna and also diode is ON in this iteration which is responsible for the dual band resonance of the antenna at 2.09GHz and 3.27GHz.The gain of the antenna at 3.27GHz is extremely low which is 0.04 dB and this detrimental effect of the substrate on the gain can be rectified by replacing the FR4 substrate with the Rogers duroid substrate. The actuation of the two PIN diodes reconfigures the resonance to 2.45GHz and 3.36GHz making it suitable for WLAN and 5G n78 band wireless applications.

articleTitle: Comparison of Machine Learning Models for Multiple Hand-Written Digits Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Hand-written digit recognition is the process of enabling machines to identify human hand-written digits. A highly proficient algorithm is required when dealing with handwriting recognition due to its complexity. A neural network is a mathematical representation of how the brain functions. It comprises numerous layers with numerous activations, these activations mimic the neurons in the human brain. To recognize the underlying relationships, a neural network attempts to acquire and learn a set of parameters from a set of data. Neural networks yields better results as they have the ability to adapt to changing input, without changing the output criteria. The MNIST dataset is widely used for the hand-written digit recognition process and it has 70000 handwritten digits. In this paper, convolution neural networks are used to train these images and build a machine-learning model. In order to reduce the illumination, image binarization and reshaping are carried out on the images. The model is successfully trained and reached a validation accuracy of 99.27%. To make it user-friendly canvas is created with the help of GUI where the user can write multiple hand-written digits and in return the image is analyzed by the model and the detected result can be viewed in the canvas. The processing of bank checks, filling out forms, and sorting mail are a few uses for digit recognition. CNNs are usually regarded as the best algorithm for hand-written digit recognition with a test accuracy of 99.26%, followed by SVM with a test accuracy of 89.34% and LeNet-5 with a test accuracy of 97.13%.

articleTitle: Authentication of Digital Document using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In today's technology-driven landscape, the ease of access to information has led to a pressing concern: the proliferation of counterfeit documents. Document authentication plays a pivotal role in our daily lives, where proving our identity is crucial. Various identification documents like Aadhar cards, PAN cards, driving licenses, and passports require validation by human operators. To counteract the challenge of counterfeit documents, a highly accurate automated system has been devised. This system employs gradient optimization and domain-specific factors for matching ID documents with live face images. Addressing the scarcity of samples in numerous classes, a pair of interconnected systems with shared parameters facilitates efficient classifier strength training. The decentralized framework utilizes Ethereum blockchain-based innovation, ensuring digital document security through online storage, hashing, face verification, a peer-to-peer infrastructure, and QR code confirmation.

articleTitle: Six-Axis Robotic Arm Integration with Computer Vision for Autonomous Object Detection using TensorFlow
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Industry 4.0 have transformed the fabrication industry by increasing productivity, product quality, and reducing production costs. The application of robotic arms in fabrication has become a more viable option due to their ability to perform repetitive tasks with high precision and accuracy, leading to increased efficiency and productivity. In this paper, we have proposed the design and implementation of a six-axial automated industrial robotic arm system using TensorFlow object detection. The proposed system includes a six-DOF(degree-of-freedom) robotic arm with a gripper, which is controlled by an Arduino uno microcontroller. The system is equipped with a camera and a TensorFlow object detection algorithm for object recognition. The fusion of these technologies facilitates the robotic arm to autonomously manipulate the positions of objects in a manufacturing setup. The system offers a low-cost and productive solution for industrial automation, which results in increased productivity and reduced labor costs. This paper contributes to the field of industrial robotics by demonstrating the potential of using open-source technologies such as TensorFlow and Arduino for designing and implementing industrial automation systems.

articleTitle: Pandemic Protocol for Broadcasting in Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In the evolution of technology, the Web 3.0 has become the future of the technological world. The web 3.0, which is still evolving, aims in creating an immersive environment which contains smart applications supported by AI and aims in decentralization of data. In the upcoming era, the successor of today’s transactions is most likely to be the transactions through cryptocurrency, which is built on top of the blockchain technology. It is important to make the upcoming technology more reliable, secure, and fast to bring it to real-time use. To overcome the low throughput and high latency of broadcasting in blockchain technology this paper comes up with the pandemic protocol for broadcasting. Communication can be the most important part of any network to work efficiently. It is a communication protocol used for broadcasting which works on the principle of how the pandemic Covid-19 spread. The implementation of this protocol in the blockchain technology to broadcast the transactions can make the technology more efficient and faster. This implementation will be tested for its efficiency and its throughput, analyze its performance, and resolve issues. Overall, this work will help in remove the inadequacies of existing communication protocols thus helping in demonstrating the benefits of this pandemic protocol for communication. The Pandemic Protocol minimizes data redundancy, reducing latency and network congestion, a significant improvement over traditional protocol. In the Web 3.0 era, the Pandemic Protocol’s efficient communication capabilities make it ideal for real-time applications and network scalability. By minimizing redundant data, it bolsters security, reducing the risk of data tampering and strengthening data integrity. Unlike energy-intensive protocols like Proof of Work (PoW), the Pandemic Protocol minimizes resource consumption, making it eco-friendly and cost-effective.

articleTitle: Prediction of Long-Term Stock returns using Long Short Term Memory Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The stock market is a popular investment option for investors because of its expected high returns. However, accurately predicting the behavior of the stock market is a challenging task as it is influenced by a range of factors, including economic conditions, geopolitical events, and global trends. In recent years, many machine learning techniques have been proposed and applied to efficiently and accurately forecast the stock prices for trading. Investment, on the other hand, is a long-term strategy that offers several advantages over trading. Investment provides compounding, reduced risk, lower transaction costs, tax benefits, and requires minimal time commitment, making it an ideal option for those looking to grow their wealth over time. Our project is to forecast stock prices for long term with the help of Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), which is a type of RNN allowing the network to selectively store or forget information in the cell state based on the current input and previous state. The findings of this study can benefit investors and financial institutions in making informed investment decisions.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficient Clustering and Routing Algorithm using Harris-Hawk Optimization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) data communication is accomplished through various cluster-based routing protocols. In wireless sensor networks (WSNs), efficient clustering and routing face significant challenges. Cluster-based routing techniques for energy-efficient transmission are based on cluster formation and cluster head (CH) selection. CH are entirely liable for data packet transport between nodes. Such protocols, however, are vulnerable to network attacks. This paper proposes a unique cluster-based routing protocol. For clustering Harris-hawk optimization (HHO) algorithm is used, and Energy Aware Temporally Ordered Routing Algorithm (TORA) protocol is used for routing. According to the experimental results, the suggested system has more advantages regarding packet delivery ratio (PDR), throughput, end-to-end delay, energy consumption, and bit error rate (BER).

Author Keywords: Energy Aware Temporally Ordered Routing Algorithm

articleTitle: Investigating Rain Attenuation and Doppler Effects in 5G-Based V2V and V2I Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication is a fundamental component of future intelligent transportation systems. However, the reliable deployment of V2V communication in adverse weather conditions remains a critical challenge. In this paper, we investigate the effect of rain attenuation on 5G-based V2V and V2I (Vehicle to Infrastructure) communication systems. To assess the severity of rain attenuation, we have done simulation, considering varying rainfall rates, frequencies and ranges. Based on the simulation result, we conclude that selection of operating frequency depends on amount of rainfall and communication range. Additionally, we discuss the Doppler shift effects, which arise due to the relative motion of V2V node. The findings from our investigation provide valuable insights for optimizing 5G V2V communication systems to maintain consistent and robust performance under varying weather conditions.

articleTitle: Trust- Aware and Energy-Optimized Enhanced Coverage Routing Protocol for 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In cellular networks, multiple devices are rapidly and increasingly being connected. It is indeed a challenge for the upcoming generation to handle these wide spread networks. 6G is considered to be the most challenging future generation communication technology, were new methods for data exchange and communication can be incorporated. There is a need for the devices to rely on either mesh-based networks or ad-hoc networks, especially during a post disaster scenario where the network infrastructure gets damaged. There is also a need for a communication network such as an ad-hoc network to be functioned by using the fundamental requirements of a 6G communication technology. The basic requirements include latency, data rate and communication frequency. To achieve the specified necessities, there is a need for the prevalence of the devices in its close proximity to one another. Solutions are formulated to design a broad network coverage area using the predominant Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies. The paper presents Network Extension and Security (NEXUS), a 6G routing protocol that supports Artificial Intelligence (AI) for extending the network coverage area. Here the connection of the nodes to an Access Point (AP) is also taken into account. NEXUS uses multiple messages to reach the nodes that are far away from the AP for communication. In case of the absence of such nodes, the protocol chooses one of its connected neighbours to see through the gap. To bolster the performance of the protocol, Reinforcement Learning (RL), Supervised Learning (SL), and Graph Neural Network (GNN) are combined to provide a sophisticated AI-based approach. The inferred RL, SL and GNN are incorporated in 6G routing protocol to increase the network coverage. NEXUS provides a high data rate with acceptable latency and low energy and storage costs. Additionally, it also offers an enhanced security level by integrating trust as an additional parameter at the network level.

articleTitle: Prediction of Cardio Vascular Diseases using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In recent decades, heart disease and stroke have emerged as the leading killers. Heart disease and stroke cause about 31% of annual deaths worldwide. Most people with deemphasizing the importance of regular health screenings they have it until its too late, and others have trouble reducing the impact of risk factors. Medical researchers have been hard at work developing a model for early disease detection in an effort to head off a catastrophic outcome. Shaping a rapidly evolving digital landscape; machine learning is highlighting invaluable contributions in early coronary heart disease prediction. This paper provides a concise overview of the several ML algorithms that have been developed to predict cardiovascular illnesses

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Bio-Signal Processing Algorithms for Heart Rate Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: A signal processing algorithm for processing the Photoplethysmography (PPG) signal to determine the heart rate is proposed. The algorithm adapts the autocorrelation function to derive the heart rate parameter. The implementation employs a Tiva C series microcontroller (TM4C123GH6PM) as a hardware component responsible for data processing. This hardware component is skillfully enhanced by the software tool Energia, resulting in improved data processing efficiency. The detected heart rate is transmitted to a smartphone through an HC-05 module. This aids in remotely monitoring a patient’s vital signs, which is particularly valuable during a pandemic when close physical proximity to the patient is discouraged.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Energy Consumption Monitoring and Control System for a Single-Phase Building
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The increase in energy consumption demand has prompted the development of an IoT-based energy consumption monitoring and control system for single-phase buildings. This study aimed to integrate IoT-based monitoring with energy control using a PZEM004t module, ESP32 TTGO TCALL, relays, and contactors directly installed in the breaker. The objectives were to design and develop an energy control mechanism with IoT-based monitoring and to validate its accuracy and precision. The methodology included system design, hardware and software testing, and performance evaluation. The study found that the proposed IoT-based energy consumption monitoring and control system provided precise and accurate data on energy consumption, as evidenced by an average percent error of only 0.5 when compared to a watt-hour meter. The mobile and web application integration made it easy to remotely monitor and control energy consumption. Experimental data validated the system’s accuracy and precision, demonstrating efficient energy consumption control. In conclusion, the study demonstrated the feasibility of using an IoT-based energy consumption monitoring and control system to regulate energy consumption in single-phase buildings. The system’s integration with mobile and web applications makes it a viable solution for sustainable energy management in modern buildings.

articleTitle: Batwing Compiler: An Artificial Intelligence based Compiler
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The dynamic landscape of programming languages presents both opportunities and challenges for software developers. This research introduces an innovative approach aimed at streamlining the coding process and bolstering developer productivity. It entails the creation of an AI-based compiler meticulously tailored to the Batwing programming language, with a primary focus on providing an accessible platform for beginners to learn coding in a comprehensible manner. Notably, this compiler caters to non-English speakers, offering native coding as a fundamental feature to enhance proficiency in programming languages. Central to this paper is an in-depth exploration of the Code Standardizer module. Furthermore, it presents a suite of versatile features designed to meet the diverse needs of both professional software developers and novice learners. These attributes empower users to efficiently tackle coding tasks, fostering a seamless transition from initial learning stages to advanced programming proficiency. In essence, this research encapsulates a transformative initiative that leverages AI-driven technology to simplify and democratize coding education. By making coding more accessible and intuitive, this compiler contributes to bridging the digital divide, enabling a broader and more diverse audience to participate in the world of programming.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Diseases Divination using Artificial Neural Network with Ensemble Models
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Health is wealth, but nowadays, wealth is health, where humans keep running their day-to-day activities without caring about their health for various reasons. Every human being in this world suffers from one or other diseases. Recently, cardiovascular diseases like heart attacks are prevalent in all age groups. Addressing cardiovascular diseases is essential before the disease reaches a crucial stage. Nowadays, artificial intelligence algorithms have been used to detect diseases in their early stages. In this piece of writing, a model of an artificial neural network is utilised to analyze, detect and predict the likelihood of cardiovascular disease in the early stages. In this proposed work, feed forward propagation, forward the input data to learn and map the relationships between inputs and outputs, and backward propagation is used to reduce the errors in the data. Further, an ensemble learning stacked model is used to achieve high accuracy in the prediction of diseases. To verify the correctness of the model, ensemble learning to stack is executed with three different models, namely Model 1, Model 2, and Model 3, with varying sets of feature selections. The experiment results show an accuracy rate of 93% in their predictions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Plant Health: Deep Learning Approaches for Precise Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The occurrence of plant diseases has an awfully adverse impact on agriculture and farmers. When plant diseases are not identified in time, the disease spreads, and food insecurity will increase. Early detection of these diseases is necessary to prevent and control them. Plant disease is a main source for identifying plant diseases since most symptoms of plant disease appear on their leaves. So, we can use leaves to predict the disease a plant might be infected with by analyzing the patterns on these leaves. To do this, we use machine learning or deep learning algorithms to train image data on the leaves and predict the diseases. The machine learning and deep learning algorithms were analyzed and compared to predict plant diseases. In deep learning, Densenet has proven to be the most suitable algorithm for plant disease detection.

articleTitle: Improvisation of Electric Vehicle Charging using PV Module and Efficient Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The effect of global warming is increasing day by day because of the usage of non-renewable fossil fuel and Internal Combustion engines. To decrease the effect the concept of using electric vehicles has been gaining popularity in recent years but it will raise the power demand in the grid. To reduce the power demand usage, renewable energy sources come into the picture. In this proposed design, solar panels and wind turbines are on the top of the vehicle, which allows them to collect energy while the vehicle is in motion. The energy collected is then stored in batteries and power the vehicle's motor. The solar panels and wind turbines work together to maximize energy production. When the vehicle is moving, the wind turbines generate electricity, and when the vehicle is stationary, the solar panels generate electricity. The design also incorporates a wing-like structure that helps to reduce drag and increase the efficiency of the vehicle. The wing structure is made of lightweight materials such as carbon fiber and is designed to be adjustable to optimize the vehicle's aerodynamics. This concept has the possible to suggestively decrease the carbon footprint of transportation in addition provide a sustainable and efficient means of transportation.

articleTitle: Energy Transfer Data Communication in Wireless Sensor Network Using Improved Firefly Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The wireless transmission of energy via directed radio frequency waves has the potential to produce always working sensor nodes by refilling the energy stored in the restricted on-board battery. The sensor nodes in WSNs collect environmental data, which is subsequently progressively sent to the networks. The sensor gathers signals and transmits them as data. The data are then relayed over a number of wireless nodes before being sent to the originating node. The large data transfer and high energy consumption of WSNs was not be successfully balanced by the existing routing techniques. In this paper the improved Firefly optimization approach is introduced to avoid this problem. The potential of the newly developed, nature-inspired Firefly algorithm for optimization reduces and addresses a variety of issues in WSN. The improved firefly technique is implemented in this study to find the correct path in sensor networks to transmit the data. In this paper the comparison of numerous network performance measures including average energy consumption (8.6J) end-to-end latency (2.2 ms), packet delivery ratio (1%), throughput (400 kbps), packet loss ratio (0.1%), are used to assess or analyse this routing system. To demonstrate the protocol’s superiority over current protocols, it was compared to them.

articleTitle: ANN based SEPIC Converter for Electric Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In this paper, a Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter (SEPIC) topology with Power Factor Correction (PFC) is presented as a method for charging the battery of an electric vehicle. This converter offers advantages such as reducing the total number of components and reducing the conduction loss during AC to DC conversion, leading to a higher overall system efficiency. The working functionality of the SEPIC-PFC converter is enhanced by using Proportional Integral (PI) controller. By using supercapacitors to collect energy, the batteries experience less stress, resulting in longer battery life and lower costs. The Multi Source Inverter (MSI) is deployed for converting DC voltage into AC voltage, and it also controls the flow of electrical power. The recommended MSI for Electric Vehicle (EV) battery system with ANN Feedback line controller is designed to enhance the effectiveness of the suggested approach by managing the State of Charge (SOC).By integrating an ANN feedback line controller for bidirectional DC/DC converter, energy management is attained with enhanced battery charging and discharging. Based on simulation results attained in MATLAB/Simulink, the proposed control technique is shown to perform well and is robust. The suggested method demonstrates that, with the offered sufficient training data for the ANN models, highly precise SOC estimated outcomes are accomplished.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction System for Heterogeneous green Cellular Networks (Hetnets)
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The development of cellular technology results in a rapid increase in cellular network traffic. For networks to improve their quality of service (QoS), time-series models which are used to forecast the cellular traffic have become crucial.To maximize the use of available resources, cellular network loading modelling and forecasting are necessary for the allocation of bandwidth provisioning while maintaining the maximum network utilisation. It is required to improve the network’s performance and quality even if many users are present in the network. This can be achieved by enhancing the network performance with reduced energy consumption, which can then be used to simplify and ease the lives of consumers by appropriately serving their demands. The novelty introduced in this work is to create a model that can assist with accurately forecasting load traffic in cellular networks. This paper discuss about a regression model with different algorithms to predict the cellular traffic. The intelligent model predicts the traffic with the help of real time traffic data set obtained from Kaggle dataset. The comparison results of the traffic prediction model for the three regression algorithms are presented. The suggested solution performed better than expected when it came to predict cellular network traffic. The implementation of prediction in heterogeneous cellular networks provides a pathway for the energy efficient green cellular networks.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Pruned Approximate Majority Logic Based Adder
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Approximate computing acts as a new concept for nanoscale technologies, which helps to reduce power without giving accurate results. Fundamentally important 3input majority voter, MV of Majority logic (ML)) is utilized in new nanotechnologies. MV has been widely used in digital circuit design. To achieve performance and accuracy tradeoffs, this work employs pruning technique in the design of ML adders. Time consumption, gates requirement and error analysis are used to investigate the proposed design. Xilinx ISE 14.7 software is employed to verify the functionality and to analyse the hardware performance metrics of the proposed circuit design and Python Jupyter Notebook is used to find error metrics.

articleTitle: Application of Geospatial Techniques for Estimating and Simulating Soil Erosion and Sediment Yield in Mat-I Creek, Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte, Philippines
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The Mat-I Creek, one of the creeks in Las Nieves, Agusan del Norte that leads directly to the Agusan River, has been reported to have high cases of sedimentation. This study simulates and estimates sediment yield and soil erosion in Mat-I Creek using various geospatial and hydrological modeling techniques. The sediment yield was calculated per rainfall using the Modified Universal Soil Loss Equation (MUSLE). The average annual soil loss of the watershed was calculated using the Revised Universal Soil Loss Equation (RUSLE). The total sedimentation of the watershed in the rainfall event before Typhoon Odette during a moderate rainfall event was 596.84 cubic meters. During Typhoon Odette, it reached 39494.48 cubic meters and revealed four subbasins yielding a relatively high sediment yield. The study results indicate that changes in a particular area of a watershed can influence the behavior of the sedimentation of the said watershed.

articleTitle: Implementation of an Anti-counterfeit Pharmaceutical Supply chain System
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Increasing complexity in the security of the pharmaceutical industry has raised concerns about the safety of drugs during transportation of the supply chain. Counterfeit drugs and the risk of unauthorized access during transportation pose a serious threat. To solve these problems, the paper aims to improve drug safety and transparency in supply chain of pharmaceutical industry. This paper focuses on developing an IoT and RFID technology-based system, which aims to track and monitor the entire transportation process of the medicine container from the manufacturer to the retailer. The system enables real-time tracking of the location and status of drug tampering to all authorized stakeholders including wholesalers, retailers, and medical facilities. This can improve drug safety and prevent counterfeit drugs using IoT and RFID technology. Real-time monitoring of the system and system design enables stakeholders to gain trust, enabling quick responses to identified problems.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of IoT based Human Gender Classification and Record Management using Intelligent Hybrid Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: There has been a lot of recent interest in automatically predicting age and gender from facial images because to the several uses this has in different kinds of facial investigations. Using the aforementioned technology, we can tell a person’s age and gender from only one image. In this research, we develop a unique deep learning approach, Intelligent Hybrid Learning Principles (IHLP), and apply it to the task of classifying facial images according to gender. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), a standard learning technique, serve as the inspiration for the suggested logic. Both models were tested in experiments designed to see how well they could distinguish between male and female faces. To approximately estimate a human face’s gender and age from a picture, the primary goal of this research is to apply a deep learning based IHLP to construct a gender and age detector. In order to accomplish a gender classification/identification job, automatic face recognition seeks to extract the important bits of information from humans and combine them into a usable representation. All of them, however, have something holding them back, such as inaccurate or incomplete reflection of the face’s structure or texture. Both alignment of faces and identification of faces may benefit greatly from this method. We propose a straightforward convolutional neural network design based on Intelligent Hybrid Learning Principles for this purpose, which can be used even in the face of a scarcity of training data. The effectiveness of the suggested method is shown by cross-validation using a model of a convolutional neural network, which then serves as evidence for the resultant section. Apart from this an advanced logic of Internet of Things (IoT) is adopted over this approach to maintain the records clearly for further analysis and it is easy to recover the records for further use.

articleTitle: Face Feature Analysis for Facial Paralysis Detection caused by Acute Stroke through DenseNet121
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Brain stroke is the important cause for disability. After an acute symptom, affected people frequently experience speech difficulty. Due to a lack of oxygen and nutrients, which are necessary for nerve cells to function, blood vessel obstruction causes nerve cells to die. Understanding the location and position of the block is crucial for stroke prediction. The likelihood of disability and the possibility of mortality can be reduced with an accurate assessment, quick therapy, and hospitalisation. Face weakness is a prominent stroke symptom. Existing techniques like tele stroke systems are far from being broadly applicable since they require complicated arrangements. The proposed work deals about the computational image analysis-based technique for automatically detecting abnormal facial weakness. Face feature analysis is used for extracting features like eye shape, movement, wrinkle in the static images. The suggested approach can extract features and classify the disease using Densenet 121 model.

articleTitle: Unified Reversible logic gate for Half Add/Subtract and Swap Operations
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: The reversible logic gates are the most eminent enabled technology for energy efficient system realization. This paper introduced a unified reversible logic gate called HAS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> gate for performing arithmetic addition/subtraction and swap operations. The designed gate can also perform other Boolean functions as copy, NOT, AND, Exclusive-OR and Exclusive-NOR. The proposed gate is compared with other existing gates regarding quantum cost, garbage values and count of reversible gates.

articleTitle: Removing of Multiple Votes using De-Duplication Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: In this paper, we pioneered a de-duplication analysis method to eradicate multiple votes, upholding election accuracy and fairness. By scrutinizing key voter details like name and date of birth, we pinpointed duplicates and used a robust data-cleaning algorithm to ensure only legitimate votes were tallied. Strong security measures, including encryption and access control, were implemented to maintain data integrity. Our project showcased the efficacy of de-duplication analysis in enhancing election security. This combined with advanced security protocols forms a blueprint for transparent electoral processes. This significant advancement emphasizes the potential of advanced data analysis in ensuring secure and transparent elections.

articleTitle: Pairwise Sequence Alignment in Biological Sequences using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
abstract: Sequence alignment is a method of positioning two (Pairwise Alignment) or more (Multiple Sequence Alignment) biological sequences of characters (such as DNA, RNA, or Protein sequences) in order to find areas of similarity. It’s possible that similarities between these sequences result from their functional or evolutionary connections. The study primarily focuses on the DNA Pairwise Alignment, which reveals the similarities and contrasts between two DNA sequences. The Needleman-Wunsch algorithm and the Smith-Waterman algorithm, two existing pairwise sequence alignment techniques, both have shortcomings in terms of computational accuracy and efficiency. Sequence alignment over enormous databases is unable to give results in a reasonable amount of time, power, or money. Using a Multilayer Perceptron trained with Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), a novel method for pairwise sequence alignment in DNA has been developed. The PSO algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the MLP for better alignment performance.

articleTitle: Switch Controlled State Skipping Based Memory Efficient Test Pattern Generator for BIST Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Second International Conference on Advances in Computational Intelligence and Communication (ICACIC)
